subject: Mosaic plan reset — phased MAP + evaluation cadence
messages:
From: Sophie Green <sophie.green@stellarsys.io>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 08:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — procurement update

Hi Chloe,

Quick follow-up from our procurement team: they just flagged an internal vendor verification step that pushes our internal approval window out by ~10 business days. That creates a gap between the MAP milestones we discussed and the original eval start date.

Can we do a short call Monday to talk through a phased approach? Ideally we want to preserve the canary eval so we can still sign off on quality before a full cutover.

Also looping in procurement (procurement@stellarsys.io) so they can chime in on required artifacts.

Thanks — Sophie

Sophie Green
Director, Platform Integrations
StellarSys
From: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
To: Sophie Green <sophie.green@stellarsys.io>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — procurement update

Sophie — thanks for the heads up.

We can do a phased MAP that decouples the canary evaluation from full production cutover. Proposed immediate adjustments: 

- Phase A (canary): run a 3-day canary eval with a 1% traffic sample to validate prompts/latency/cost (target window: Dec 8–10).
- Phase B (staged roll): once procurement completes, expand to 30% traffic for 5 business days and run load/throughput tests (target window: Dec 22–26).
- Phase C (final): full cutover after exec sign-off and completed SOC/contract signatures.

I've attached an updated MAP (StellarSys-MAP-v2.xlsx) and a draft SOW with milestone dates. Ben — can you add a compact risk register and callout items we should insist procurement confirms before Phase B? Rishi — will need your guidance on SLA gating and fallback tolerance for canary.

If that aligns, let's get a 30-minute call Monday (Nov 24) 9am PT. Sophie — if procurement needs different timing, shout it out and we can rebaseline.

Thanks,

Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: StellarSys-MAP-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), StellarSys-SOW-draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, Sophie Green <sophie.green@stellarsys.io>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff — procurement update

Quick risk register notes (high level):

1) Procurement verification gating (medium): if StellarSys requires additional vendor questionnaires, Phase B may slip 7–12 business days. Mitigation: provide completed SOC 2 summary, sample audit logs, and a point-by-point tech appendix (we can expedite).

2) Canary data sensitivity (low): need explicit rules on PII redaction for canary; suggest masking rules in the MAP appendix.

3) Load variance (medium-high): traffic patterns may cause longer token processing times — propose a throttled ramp for Phase B (10% -> 30% over 48 hours) to protect latency SLOs.

4) Rollback path clarity (high): define automatic fallback to hosted smaller model variant if latency or error rate breaches thresholds during Phase B. Rishi, recommend specifics here.

Action items: Ben to add the above into the MAP (done) and flag the top three procurement artifacts. Chloe to request procurement timelines; Rishi to specify SLA gating metrics (error %, p95 latency).

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Sophie Green <sophie.green@stellarsys.io>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@stellarsys.io, Tom Kline <tom.kline@stellarsys.io>
Date: Wed, 26 Nov 2025 07:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — procurement update

Thanks — this looks reasonable. Procurement confirms the vendor verification will complete by Dec 15 at the earliest; they need the sample audit logs and a short security appendix. We'll confirm PII redaction rules by end of day tomorrow.

Tom (cc'd) — can you confirm executive availability for a brief approval window the week of Dec 29? Our CFO prefers Dec 30 but open to slipping if Redwood needs a working day.

If Dec 15 vendor clearance holds, your phased plan keeps the canary earlier than full cutover, which is ideal. We'll sign the SOW pending legal's minor redlines.

Sophie
From: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, Sophie Green <sophie.green@stellarsys.io>
Date: Thu, 27 Nov 2025 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: ACTION: escalate procurement timing for RDW-2025-784

Laura / Rishi — follow-up and ask for escalation: StellarSys' procurement clearance now targets Dec 15 which pushes Phase B and full cutover into late December. That creates risk with year-end exec availability and our rollout window.

Summary of current position:
- Phase A (canary) proposed: Dec 8–10 (on track)
- Procurement clearance: Dec 15 (earliest) -> Phase B earliest start Dec 22 (tight overlap with holidays)
- Exec approval likely week of Dec 29 (Tom suggested Dec 30)

Request: can we approve an expedited procurement support package (one-off) to provide the extra artifacts (SOC summary, audit log extract, technical appendix) and a short waiver form so procurement can checkpoint earlier? If we can buy a 3-business-day procurement concierge support, we reduce the slip risk by ~7 days and recover the Phase B window into Dec 15–19.

If not, we should formally rebaseline the MAP and notify StellarSys of revised gating dates and a fallback cadence that shifts final cutover to mid-Jan. Chloe to own external comms after decision.
